name: Bijie, Guizhou
intro: Bijie is Guizhou's wild wonder — home to Zhijin Cave, one of China's most spectacular caverns, the springtime sea of colour at the Azalea Reserve, and Caohai Lake, a haven for black-necked cranes. A nature-lover's recovery retreat.

highlights.name: Zhijin Cave (织金洞)
highlights.description: Dubbed 'the king of caves in China' — vast chambers of stalactites lit like a natural cathedral.

highlights.name: Baili Azalea (百里杜鹃)
highlights.description: In spring, 100 li (50 km) of hills blaze with wild azaleas — one of Earth's great floral displays.

highlights.name: Caohai Wetland (草海)
highlights.description: A highland lake and crucial wintering ground for rare black-necked cranes — paradise for birdwatchers.

highlights.name: Zhijin Grand Canyon
highlights.description: Sheer cliffs, gorges and a glass walkway for the brave.

medical.advantages: Bijie's partner clinic offers the group's clinical standards in a tranquil, low-cost setting surrounded by nature — perfect for a restful recovery.

institutions.name: Jingzhou Dental — Bijie Clinic
institutions.description: A community clinic bringing trusted dental care to northwest Guizhou's nature seekers.

doctors.name: Dr. Sun Lei
doctors.title: General Dentist
doctors.bio: Steady, experienced clinician focused on long-term oral health.
